title: Healthy Student Habits & Lifestyle
content: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle as a university student involves balancing academics, social life, and self-care. Focus on consistent hydration (aiming for 2-3 liters of water daily), taking frequent study breaks using the Pomodoro technique (5-minute break every 25 minutes of work), and spending at least 15-20 minutes daily outdoors or in green spaces to reduce fatigue.

title: General Wellness Resources
content: Wellness is a proactive approach to physical, mental, and social well-being. Students are encouraged to use the wellness center facilities, join mindfulness circles, and attend wellness workshops organized by the Campus Wellness Club every Tuesday at the Central Block auditorium.
